henry.title: Edinburgh Castle: Attacked Again and Again
steps: 📖 Read each chunk below. Tap 🔊 if you want.
links: Only if you want more. Look for the 'Did you know' boxes.
Click 'Reject all and close' on the cookie box.
worksheet: Iron Age people built a ______ fort. Circle: hill / sand
Who led the 1314 raid? Circle: Thomas Randolph / Mons Meg
The 1715 ladder was too ______. Circle: short / long
Honours: crown, ______, sword. Circle: sceptre / spoon
Put in order 1, 2, 3: ___ Mons Meg (1457) ___ Scots retake castle (1314) ___ Honours first used (1543)
Challenge: ___ days to pull Mons Meg 15 km.

passage.text: 🏰 Edinburgh Castle sits on a big rock. Long ago, Iron Age people built a hill fort there.
passage.q: What did Iron Age people build?

passage.text: ⚔️ Armies attacked the castle many times. In 1314 the Scots took it back in a night raid. Thomas Randolph led it.
🪜 In 1715 some men tried to climb the walls. Their ladder was too short. The attack failed!
👑 The Honours of Scotland are the crown, the sceptre and the sword. They are the oldest crown jewels in Britain. They were first used together in 1543.
💥 Mons Meg is a giant cannon from 1457. Oxen could pull her only 5 km a day.
passage.q: How far could oxen pull her in a day?

words: surrounding a place to capture it
henry.challenge: Mons Meg is pulled 5 km a day. How many days to pull her 15 km? Then read more on the castle website (bonus link).
